summary: Proposal only, awaiting Root: ADR-0098 (docs/adr/0098-per-resource-publication-claims-for-disjoint-writers.md, Proposed) would let writers with disjoint package/tag/release/journal keys overlap, via a capacity-N extension of the ADR-0097 lock plus epoch-fenced claim refs in the Authority repository (create-if-absent, non-forced fast-forward, takeover only after expiry and holder-not-live) and a send-boundary re-read that extends the currently unused BoundIntentFence. The aggregate profile is derived from existing ceilings (4200/4500 recovery and Creator, 1500/1800 ordinary), so at a 5000 core limit only one max-profile writer or two ordinary writers fit; the proposed cap N=2 is policy, not measured capacity. ADR-0097 stays the rule. Root's 2026-10-24 decision chose serialization instead of this profile, which Root must reconcile. Limits: no implementation, destination duplicate-rejection behaviour is unqualified, the live Authority limit and hosted concurrency are unread, and nothing grants publication or effect authority.
title: Proposed per-resource claims for disjoint publication writers (ADR-0098, not accepted)
